hero.title: Initiatives & Events
hero.description: Various initiatives undertaken for village development and social responsibility.
hero.caption: Together, we work towards a cleaner, greener and better village.

intro.title: Working Together for Village Development
intro.description: The Gram Panchayat organizes various initiatives and community activities to improve village life and promote social responsibility.
intro.descriptionTwo: These activities encourage public participation, environmental protection, cleanliness, health awareness and the overall development of our village.
intro.highlightDescription: Every initiative becomes successful through the active participation, cooperation and dedication of villagers.

activities.title: Village Initiatives & Activities
activities.description: A glimpse of the activities organized by the Gram Panchayat and villagers for the betterment of our community.

treePlantation.title: Mega Tree Plantation Campaign 2024
treePlantation.description: A total of 500 trees were planted in open spaces in the village and around the cremation ground. Young people participated enthusiastically in this initiative.

cleanliness.title: Cleanliness Campaign on the Occasion of Gandhi Jayanti
cleanliness.description: The entire village was cleaned under the 'Clean Village, Beautiful Village' initiative. A demonstration of wet and dry waste segregation was also conducted.

healthCamp.title: Free Eye Examination and Health Camp
healthCamp.description: A free eye examination and cataract surgery camp for senior citizens was organized at the Primary Health Centre.

womenGathering.title: International Women's Day and Haldi Kumkum Celebration
womenGathering.description: A women's gathering was organized in the village on the occasion of Women's Day. Guidance was provided to self-help groups, along with a Haldi Kumkum programme.

gramSabha.title: Special Gram Sabha on Independence Day
gramSabha.description: A special Gram Sabha was organized to discuss issues related to the village water supply and road development.

shramdaan.title: Save Water, Recharge Water – Community Voluntary Work
shramdaan.description: Villagers contributed one day of voluntary labour to deepen the village stream and construct bunds, highlighting the importance of water conservation.

closing.title: Together, We Can Build a Better Village
closing.description: The active participation of every villager makes our development initiatives meaningful. Let us continue working together for the progress and well-being of our village.
